stories.title: Motorista de van perde o controle e bate em passarela na BR-101, em João Pessoa

en.title: Delivery van driver loses control and hits overpass on BR-101 in João Pessoa
en.summary: A delivery van driver lost control of the vehicle and collided with an overpass pillar on BR-101 in João Pessoa. Federal Highway Police indicate the driver may have fallen ill before the accident.

stories.title: Pai e político há mais de 10 anos: saiba quem era o deputado estadual Amilton Filho, que morreu em acidente na BR-050

en.title: Father and politician for over 10 years: learn who state deputy Amilton Filho was, who died in an accident on BR-050
en.summary: Goiás state deputy Amilton Filho, 41, married with two children, died in a traffic accident on BR-050 while traveling to a campaign event for his reelection bid.

stories.title: 'Coração Selvagem' filma o entendimento pleno entre homem e cachorro

en.title: 'Wild Heart' films the full understanding between man and dog
en.summary: The film 'Wild Heart' follows Lieutenant James Belmont, played by Brad Pitt, who after losing fellow soldiers in a wartime ambush, spends time camping in Alaska.

stories.title: Umidade do ar pode cair a 20% em 185 cidades do PI neste sábado (26), alerta Inmet

en.title: Air humidity may drop to 20% in 185 cities in PI this Saturday (26), warns Inmet
en.summary: Brazil's National Institute of Meteorology issued a yellow alert for 185 municipalities in Piauí with air humidity potentially reaching 20% on Saturday, recommending hydration and avoiding sun exposure.

stories.title: ‘Coração Selvagem’ traz Brad Pitt e um cachorro em aventura genuinamente emocionante

en.title: 'Wild Heart' brings Brad Pitt and a dog in a genuinely moving adventure
en.summary: A film featuring Brad Pitt and a dog offers an emotionally engaging adventure story.

stories.title: Empresas de bets têm dez dias para derrubar sites e aplicativos de apostas on-line; veja outras mudanças

en.title: Betting companies have ten days to shut down online gambling sites and apps; see other changes
en.summary: A federal provisional measure ending online betting requires betting company websites and apps to go offline within ten days, with company operating concessions ending within 30 days from the measure's publication.

stories.title: Fórmula 1: Russell supera Verstappen por 0.1s e vence GP do Azerbaijão

en.title: Formula 1: Russell surpasses Verstappen by 0.1s and wins Azerbaijan GP
en.summary: George Russell of Mercedes won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix with a narrow 0.196-second margin over Max Verstappen of Red Bull in a closely contested race featuring multiple retirements.

stories.title: Russell lidera do início ao fim e resiste à pressão de Verstappen no Azerbaijão

en.title: Russell leads from start to finish and resists Verstappen's pressure in Azerbaijan
en.summary: George Russell started from pole position and maintained his lead throughout the Azerbaijan Formula 1 Grand Prix to secure victory.

stories.title: Calor pode superar 40°C em oito Estados até quarta-feira, alerta Inmet; veja quais

en.title: Heat may exceed 40°C in eight states until Wednesday, warns Inmet; see which
en.summary: Brazil's meteorological institute has issued an alert that temperatures may surpass 40 degrees Celsius in eight states over the coming days through Wednesday.

stories.title: F1: Russell domina GP do Azerbaijão e vence a terceira em 2026; Bortoleto termina em 13º

en.title: F1: Russell dominates Azerbaijan GP and wins his third in 2026; Bortoleto finishes 13th
en.summary: Russell achieved victory at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, securing his third win of the 2026 season, while Bortoleto completed the race in 13th position.

stories.title: MP das Bets: veja o que muda e saiba datas para devolução de valores

en.title: MP das Bets: see what changes and know dates for refund of values
en.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a provisional measure Friday banning the operation, offering, intermediation and advertising of sports betting and online games in Brazil, with provisions for returning customer balances.

stories.title: Deputado estadual Amilton Filho morre aos 41 anos em acidente de carro em Goiás

en.title: State deputy Amilton Filho dies at 41 years old in car accident in Goiás
en.summary: State deputy Amilton Filho, 41 years old, died in a car accident in the state of Goiás.

stories.title: Com 'bondades', ajustes no Orçamento de 2027 já somam R$ 33 bilhões

en.title: With 'benefits', adjustments to 2027 Budget already total R$ 33 billion
en.summary: Brazil's government must adjust its 2027 budget to accommodate approximately 33 billion reais in new spending and lost revenue from Bolsa Família increases, betting restrictions, and a debt relief program extension.

stories.title: Em carreata, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula ‘está desesperado’

en.title: In campaign caravan, Flávio Bolsonaro says Lula 'is desperate'
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential candidate, stated during a campaign event that President Lula has weakened Brazil and predicted electoral defeat, while announcing plans for tax cuts if elected.

stories.title: Não investir no Brasil é um erro estrutural, diz CEO do banco Inter

en.title: Not investing in Brazil is a structural error, says Inter bank CEO
en.summary: The CEO of Inter bank stated that avoiding investments in Brazil represents a structural mistake, emphasizing long-term opportunities despite near-term market fluctuations.

stories.title: Apostas esportivas foram legalizadas pelo governo Temer e regulamentadas no governo Lula; relembre histórico

en.title: Sports betting was legalized by Temer government and regulated under Lula; recall history
en.summary: The federal government's prohibition of betting on Friday ended a legalization process that began under President Michel Temer in 2018, with regulation occurring in late 2023.

stories.title: Trump diz que quer abrir Cuba aos americanos

en.title: Trump says he wants to open Cuba to Americans
en.summary: US President Donald Trump stated he wants to open Cuba to Americans and expects the two countries to reach an agreement. Trump indicated he does not believe military action will be necessary.
